slides: Barnes didn't wait for perfect conditions He waited for the door
He didn't wait until he had saved money
He didn't wait until he was older or smarter
He didn't wait until Edison called him first
He showed up when wanting it mattered more than fear
Perfect conditions never come Only broke men believe that lie
Follow for the men willing to move before they're ready
caption:
Stop waiting for perfect conditions. That's the excuse of a broke man. Self improvement and discipline mean moving now. Barnes had zero perfect conditions when he rode that freight train to find Edison. He wasn't ready. He wasn't qualified. He didn't have the money or the connections. But he moved anyway because wanting it was stronger than the doubt. Waiting kills more dreams than failure ever could.

Send this to a man who needs it today.
